The explainers we maintain

Plain-English references on accessibility law, scoring, and WCAG

This is not a blog; we would rather keep a small number of references accurate and current than publish frequently. Below is everything we maintain today.

Guides

  • ADA website accessibility guide: what US accessibility law actually requires of an online store, who is exempt, and what a demand letter typically looks like.
  • How we score your site: the exact scoring model behind every Accessrank report: the WCAG conformance weighting, the SEO checklist, and where automated testing stops.

On the homepage

  • How it works: the four steps from the free check to a store that stays fixed.
  • WCAG 2.2 explained: the four principles behind WCAG and the success criteria we test most often.
  • Frequently asked questions: quick answers on plans, timelines, and how Accessrank works.

Want something we don't cover yet?

If there is a topic you think belongs here, email info@accessrank.ai and tell us what is missing. If you would rather have a specialist look at your own store directly, start a free scan or talk to sales.

Accessrank provides accessibility remediation and monitoring services; we are not a law firm and nothing here is legal advice. We work to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, but no website can be guaranteed to be fully accessible, and conformance reduces — but cannot eliminate — legal exposure. Statistics cited are from the named third-party sources and describe the market generally, not results you should expect. See our Disclosure.
